name: Abridge
summary: Ambient AI that drafts clinical documentation from patient conversations for health systems.
description: Abridge records clinician-patient conversations and generates clinical notes, with versions for clinicians, revenue cycle teams and nursing. It also provides an assistant and care signals inside clinical workflows. The product is sold to health systems; no public prices are listed. Its documentation is designed for billing accuracy as well as clinical use. Access is through sales to health organisations, and the product works within clinical workflows rather than as a standalone consumer app.

howToUse.title: Open Abridge
howToUse.description: Go to Abridge and look through the platform for clinical conversations. Separate areas cover clinicians, revenue cycle teams and nursing.

howToUse.title: Record the visit and draft the note
howToUse.description: Record a clinician-patient conversation and generate the clinical note. That documentation is written for billing accuracy and for clinical use.

howToUse.title: Use the assistant in the workflow
howToUse.description: Work with the assistant and with Care Signals from inside the clinical workflows. Health organisations buy through sales, the product is sold to health systems, and prices are not listed publicly.

features_fr: Ambient AI qui rédige la documentation clinique à partir des conversations des patients pour les systèmes de santé.
Abridge enregistre les conversations clinicien-patient et génère des notes cliniques, avec des versions pour les cliniciens, les équipes du cycle de revenus et les soins infirmiers.
Il fournit également un assistant et des signaux de soins dans les flux de travail cliniques.
Le produit est vendu aux systèmes de santé ; aucun prix public n'est indiqué.
